Piste reference data — confirm at source. Valley floor about 1,035 m; the Aiguille du Midi cable car tops out at 3,842 m (off-piste Vallée Blanche only); vertical derived. Search summaries (chamonix.com winter 2027 press kit; seechamonix.com) give the ski areas as 1,035–3,300 m, pistes topping out around 2,765–2,800 m at Grands Montets (to rise to 3,275 m when the new top lift is built), and a 2,800 m vertical

source.note: Search summary of Chamonix ski-area guides (seechamonix.com, InTheSnow, Bergfex; exact page per figure not distinguishable): 150+ km of pistes; 77 pistes = 13 green, 28 blue, 26 red, 10 black; 65 lifts; skiable area 115 km². The figures cover the valley's separate areas (Grands Montets, Brévent-Flégère, Balme-Vallorcine, Les Houches), which are not linked by piste. Lift types and hourly capacity were not found. New for 2026-27 (chamonix.com press kit, search summary): the first section of a new lift from Argentière to the Lognan plateau (Grands Montets) opens in December 2026, with a new beginners' area at Grands Montets.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools (e.g. ESF) and rental shops operate in the resort villages

character: The Chamonix valley below Mont Blanc groups several separate ski areas — Grands Montets above Argentière, Brévent-Flégère, Balme-Vallorcine and Les Houches — connected by road, train and valley buses rather than by piste. It is best known for steep, high-mountain and off-piste skiing, including the Vallée Blanche reached by the Aiguille du Midi cable car. For 2026-27 the first section of a new lift from Argentière to the Lognan plateau is due to open.
learning: Mixed for beginners. The 77 marked pistes include 13 green and 28 blue (search summary), and a new beginners' area at Grands Montets opens with the new Argentière lift in 2026-27 (search summary). The areas are not linked by piste, so a beginner should base near the area they will use and confirm nursery-slope access and lessons locally.

announcedOpening.text: Grands Montets and La Flégère from 28 Nov 2026 (snow permitting); Brévent and Balme-Vallorcine from 12 Dec 2026; general opening of the ski areas 12 Dec 2026 (chamonix.com winter 2027 press kit, per search summary; France Montagnes' 2026-27 list also gives 28 Nov).

announcedClosing.text: Grands Montets to 2 May 2027; the general closing of the ski areas is 18 Apr 2027 (per search summary of the chamonix.com winter 2027 press kit).

season.typicalText: 2026-27 schedule: first areas late November, all areas mid-December to mid-April, Grands Montets into early May.
season.notes: Each ski area opens and closes on its own date (see announced text). A separate search summary gave the season as 19 Dec 2026 – 2 May 2027; the official press-kit dates above are used instead. Past opening dates were not captured.
